description: This is a Java test class for testing REST API endpoints related to product management in an e-commerce application. It contains unit tests for creating manufacturers, product reviews, product option values, product options, and performing CRUD operations on products. The class uses Spring's RestTemplate for HTTP requests, Jackson for JSON serialization, and JUnit for testing annotations.
